method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual party to a VCAT proceeding, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05; dates in one module, the rules and the party's exported questions in another, worked cases in a third; six regulative rules (ss 45(2), 46(1), 114(1) and (6), 117(2), 148(2), 148(3)) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

seat: the individual party to a VCAT proceeding: the applicant who brings a claim or an application for review (for this focus typically a transport accident claimant seeking review, a consumer with a small claim, a person complaining of discrimination, a building owner), or an individual respondent (vcat-party.l4)
